title: Recruitment and Consultations plugin packages
summary: Recruitment (public board and staff manage) and Pet Care Consultations now live as first-party plugin packages, without changing live URLs, permission names, or the RecruitmentRole vacancy model.
changes: Moved Recruitment into plugins/recruitment with public /recruitment* board and apply paths plus staff /apes-cic/recruitment* manage routes.
Kept RecruitmentRole as the vacancy model (never Spatie Role) and preserved the public versus staff dual-frontend IA from 0.36.x.
Moved Consultations into plugins/consultations for Pet Care Clinic, declaring the Pet Profiles plugin dependency.
Preserved live recruitment and consultation URLs and permission strings; morph aliases and a notification stub keep existing records rendering.
affected_areas: Recruitment plugin package — public /recruitment* and staff /apes-cic/recruitment*
Morph map aliases for recruitment roles, applications, and consultations
Admin Plugins manifests for Recruitment and Consultations
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.37.x Structure line: relocates existing Recruitment and Consultations features into plugin packages without new public capability or breaking URL/permission changes.
validation: Focused PHPUnit: StructureRecruitConsultWave7Test, Recruitment dual-frontend IA matrix, recruitment/consultation workflow suites, morph/contracts
known_limitations: Architecture hard-fail tests still report-only until Wave 8.
Historical audit event key names are unchanged; new events continue to use the existing area prefixes.
rollback: Redeploy the previous Cloudron package (0.37.9). No database rename was introduced; plugin namespaces resolve via morph aliases and notification stubs.
provenance: Structure Wave 7 for issue #290 via pull request #310.
